preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 2 * 10**5 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each vertex value a_i is an integer between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n-1 edges, each connecting two distinct vertices in the range 1 to n.
The given edges form a connected acyclic graph (tree) with n vertices.

postconditions.description: The output is the maximum possible cost of the tree, where cost is defined as the sum over all vertices i of (distance from i to chosen root v) multiplied by a_i, and v is chosen optimally.

postconditions.expression: max_cost == max(sum(dist(i, v) * a_i for i in range(1, n + 1)) for v in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: The maximum cost is computed by evaluating the cost for every possible root v and selecting the maximum value.
